gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fragment-mono: Stark and wire-straight: Unica One keeps every stroke uniform, while Fragment Mono sets letters like nails on a ruler. Without thick-and-thin swings, the monospace lines glide past the eye.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-genos: Bent wire, basically: Unica One keeps its strokes constant, with daylight in every curve. And where Unica One grabs attention, Genos is the one that keeps tightly set sans text flowing.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-inder: Sheet-metal curves: Unica One never thins out at the turns, and its counters stay open. And while Unica One makes the statement, Inder keeps capitals and lowercase close in height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Flat and stencil-cut, Unica One commands the top of the page. Kdam Thmor Pro follows with sans bowls that fill the line, so paragraphs read modern and full-bodied, line after line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-krona-one: Monoweight from start to finish, Unica One looks flat and commanding. And where Unica One commands, Krona One spreads out loosely with lowercase as sturdy as cast iron capitals.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-magra: Magra, a sans-serif whose every lowercase word feels big-bodied, sits beneath Unica One, which never pinches or swells. Paragraphs in it move along solidly, with weight in every line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-major-mono-display: Unica One leads with open curves drawn in a single stroke weight. Major Mono Display follows underneath, its monospace letters like neon glass, so text reads slow, precise and spaced out.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-martian-mono: Stripped-back and open: that's Unica One up top, looking commanding. Martian Mono brings fixed-width, code-style letters, spaced loosely below, a structured and technical partner for the heading's single-thickness lines.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-matemasie: Open from the first glance, Unica One lets daylight into every curve it draws. And where Unica One draws the eye, Matemasie keeps its sans-serif letters closed, spaced broadly and quietly readable.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mitr: Unica One cuts its letters stencil-style, all in one weight. Mitr sits beneath with almost no gap between lowercase and capital height, so text reads compact, sturdy and approachable.
